sellers.name: Maya Chen
sellers.bio: Interior designer in Park Slope. I rotate furniture more than I should, so there's usually something good here. Smoke-free home.

sellers.name: Marcus Reed
sellers.bio: Bed-Stuy native, DJ on weekends. Mostly selling bikes, audio gear and records I've doubled up on. Quick replies, fair prices.

sellers.name: Priya Nair
sellers.bio: Software engineer in Astoria. I upgrade my setup too often, so my old gear goes here. Everything wiped, tested and boxed if I still have the box.

sellers.name: Tomás Alvarez
sellers.bio: Line cook and part-time skater in Bushwick. Clearing out the apartment before my lease is up. Evenings and weekends work best for pickup.

sellers.name: Hannah Goldberg
sellers.bio: Retired teacher on the Upper West Side, slowly downsizing after 30 years in the same apartment. Doorman building, easy pickup.

sellers.name: Kofi Mensah
sellers.bio: Dad of two in Crown Heights. Our kids outgrow things faster than we can store them. Happy to help carry down to your car.

sellers.name: Lena Petrova
sellers.bio: Photographer in Greenpoint, moving to Berlin in November. Selling what won't fit in two suitcases. Priced to go.

listings.title: Vintage mid-century armchair, orange floral upholstery
listings.description: 1960s lounge chair with walnut legs and the original orange-and-cream floral fabric. Frame is solid and doesn't wobble; there's light fading on the left arm and a small snag on the back. About 30" wide, 33" deep, 34" tall. Pillow not included. Pickup only, ground-floor brownstone near 7th Ave.

listings.title: Round black metal mirror with rope hanger, 20"
listings.description: 20-inch round mirror with a thin matte black frame and jute rope strap. Hung on one wall for a year, no scratches on the glass. Swapping it for something bigger in the same spot. Cash or Venmo.

listings.title: Light blue upholstered loveseat, 52"
listings.description: Compact two-seater in a pale aqua linen blend, 52" wide, wood legs. It fits through narrow brownstone doorways, which is why I bought it. Cushions are firm, no stains, one tiny pull on the front edge. Pillows and throw not included. Someone is coming Saturday; I'll update if it falls through.

listings.title: Canon AE-1 film camera with 50mm f/1.8 lens
listings.description: Canon AE-1 with the FD 50mm f/1.8. Fresh battery, meter reads accurately and the shutter doesn't squeal. Light seals were replaced last year. Shot two rolls of Portra on it this summer with no issues. Neck strap included.

listings.title: Teal yoga mat with carry strap, 4mm
listings.description: Standard 68" x 24" mat, 4mm thick, with an elastic carry strap. Used maybe ten times before I switched to a cork one. Wiped down and rolled. I can leave it with the doorman at my studio on Vanderbilt.

listings.title: L.C. Smith & Corona portable typewriter, 1930s
listings.description: Maroon Corona portable from the 1930s. All keys strike and the carriage advances, but the ribbon is dry and needs replacing. Some wear to the paint on the front edge, as you'd expect. Heavy, so pickup only. Great as a working piece or as decor.

listings.title: White rhinestone low-top sneakers, women's 7.5
listings.description: White canvas low-tops covered in small rhinestones, women's US 7.5. Wore them once to a wedding reception. No missing stones that I can find, soles are clean. Satin laces included.

listings.title: Free: two large empty picture frames
listings.description: Two empty frames, no glass or backing. The wood one is about 30" x 40", the sage green one about 20" x 28". Good for a project or a gallery wall. On my stoop until they're gone, first come first served.

listings.title: Black steel road bike, converted single speed, 56cm
listings.description: Vintage steel frame, 56cm, converted to single speed with a new chain and freewheel this spring. Drop bars, sprung leather saddle, both brakes work. Fits riders about 5'9" to 6'0". Tires hold air fine. Test ride welcome if you leave ID.

listings.title: Spin-lock dumbbell set with 6 extra cast iron plates
listings.description: Pair of chrome spin-lock handles plus cast iron plates, about 40 lb total. Threads are clean and the collars tighten fine. Some surface rust on a couple of plates. Third floor walk-up, I'll bring them down.

listings.title: Technics SL-1200MK5 turntable with Ortofon cartridge
listings.description: SL-1200MK5 in silver, Ortofon cartridge on the headshell. Pitch slider and start/stop work as they should, speed is locked on both 33 and 45. Dust cover has scratches, deck itself is clean. Selling because I went digital for gigs. Pending pickup, will relist if it doesn't happen.

listings.title: Lot of about 40 classical and pop LPs
listings.description: Box of roughly 40 records, mostly classical pressings from the 70s plus a Beatles compilation. Sleeves are worn and some have ring wear, but the vinyl I spot-checked plays fine. Selling as a lot only.

listings.title: Brown leather messenger bag, fits 13" laptop
listings.description: Full-grain brown leather messenger with two buckle straps and a padded shoulder pad. Fits a 13-inch laptop plus a camera. Leather is scuffed in the way it should be, all stitching intact. I'm at my studio in Fort Greene most afternoons.

listings.title: MacBook Pro 13" Retina, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD
listings.description: 13-inch MacBook Pro, silver, 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD. Battery cycle count is 312 and health shows normal. Wiped and reset, signed out of iCloud. Small dent on the bottom corner, screen is perfect. Comes with the original charger. Can meet at the Astoria Blvd station.

listings.title: Logitech MX Keys wireless keyboard, graphite
listings.description: MX Keys in graphite, US layout. Backlight works, pairs with three devices. I moved to a mechanical board so this has been in a drawer. USB-C cable included.

listings.title: Apple iMac 21.5", 8GB RAM, keyboard and mouse included
listings.description: 21.5-inch iMac, 8GB RAM, 1TB drive. Freshly reset to macOS. Comes with the wired keyboard and Magic Mouse. Screen has no dead pixels. It's at my office in LIC, so pickup there on weekdays. Heavy-ish, bring a bag.

listings.title: IKEA Hektar floor lamp, dark grey
listings.description: Hektar floor lamp, adjustable shade, about 69" tall. Works fine, a few small scuffs on the base. Bulb included. Pickup only, 2nd floor walk-up off 30th Ave.

listings.title: Beige carpeted cat condo with scratching posts
listings.description: Two-post cat tree with a covered cubby, about 3 feet tall. Sisal on the posts is worn from use, carpet has been vacuumed. Our cat prefers the couch, so it's going. Fits in a hatchback.

listings.title: Adult tennis racket, grip 2, with a new ball
listings.description: Adult racket, grip size 2, strung last season. Some paint chips on the frame from scraping serves. I'll throw in a fresh ball. I can meet at Astoria Park courts.

listings.title: Room in 3BR, Bushwick — $1,350/mo
listings.description: Sunny room in a 3BR off the Jefferson L, available Nov 1. The room is empty and freshly painted, with parquet floors, a closet and a big window. It fits a queen. Shared kitchen with a dishwasher, a stainless fridge and a breakfast counter. Two roommates, both in their late 20s, quiet on weeknights. Utilities split, around $80 a month.

listings.title: Wooden cruiser skateboard, 36", red wheels
listings.description: Oak-veneer cruiser, about 36 inches, soft red wheels that eat up rough pavement. Bearings spin fine, trucks are a bit loose but adjustable. Headphones not included. Can meet near Maria Hernandez Park.

listings.title: Red Vespa LX 50 scooter, 2,900 miles
listings.description: 2012 Vespa LX 50, red, 2,900 miles. Clear title in my name, registered in NY. New battery and rear tire this year, rear rack included. Starts first try. It's parked at a friend's garage in Williamsburg. Holding it for a buyer this week.

listings.title: Pair of black metal swivel stools, adjustable
listings.description: Two black steel stools with round seats that spin up and down to adjust height, about 24 to 30 inches. Sturdy, some paint wear on the footrests. Selling as a pair.

listings.title: Free: flattened moving boxes, about 25
listings.description: About 25 flattened cardboard boxes in mixed sizes, tied in bundles. Some have tape residue but all are usable. Take them all, please. Leaving them by my building door tonight, or message me and I'll hold them.

listings.title: Ornate gilt wall mirror, antique, 22"
listings.description: Heavy cast metal mirror with gilt finish, figures and a lion mask at the bottom. Roughly 22 inches tall. The mirror glass itself has the foxing and silvering loss you see in old pieces. It hung in my hallway for decades. Doorman building on West End Ave, I can have it waiting downstairs.

listings.title: Antique Jones hand-crank sewing machine
listings.description: Black Jones Family hand-crank machine with gold decals, on its original wooden base. The wheel turns and the needle moves; I haven't sewn with it in years so it may need oiling. Decals are in good shape for the age. Lid is missing. Very heavy.

listings.title: Two rattan hoop chairs and teak side table
listings.description: Pair of round rattan chairs on black metal legs plus a small slatted teak table. They lived on my daughter's covered porch for one summer and came back to me. Rug not included. Sold as a set.

listings.title: Small wooden toy train set, 4 engines
listings.description: Four little wooden engines with red wheels and the card they came with. Bought for my grandson, who has decided he prefers trucks. Solid wood, no small loose parts. Suitable for ages 3 and up.

listings.title: L.L.Bean duck boots, women's 8
listings.description: Classic L.L.Bean boots, tan leather uppers with brown rubber bottoms, women's size 8. Worn two winters, kept clean and dry. Unlined, so wear a thick sock. Laces are original.

listings.title: Round walnut dining table and matching chair
listings.description: 36-inch round table in walnut with one matching spindle-back chair. Minor surface marks on the top, nothing deep. Legs unscrew for transport. Sold, thank you all.

listings.title: Red kids tricycle, ages 2-4
listings.description: Classic red trike with chrome handlebars and streamers taken off. Wheels roll straight, seat is adjustable. Some scuffs on the step plate. My youngest moved to a balance bike. Helmet not included.

listings.title: Wooden balance bike, adjustable seat
listings.description: Birch plywood balance bike with air tires and an adjustable seat, for roughly ages 2 to 5. Both of our kids learned on it. Wood has some scratches, tires hold air. Good way to skip training wheels.

listings.title: Rattan bassinet with mattress pad
listings.description: Vintage-style rattan bassinet on four legs with a fitted mattress pad, about 33" long. Smoke-free, pet-free home. Pad cover has been washed. On hold for a neighbor until Thursday.

listings.title: Blue dog bed with horse print, medium
listings.description: Medium bolster bed, about 24" x 20", navy canvas with a white horse print. Cover is machine washable and was just washed. Our dachshund mix has graduated to the sofa.

listings.title: White folding e-bike, 20" wheels, rack battery
listings.description: Folding electric bike with 20-inch wheels, rear-rack battery and front and rear lights. Gets about 25 miles a charge on pedal assist. Folds small enough for a closet. Charger included, receipt available. My wife's sister has it in Prospect Heights, pickup there.

listings.title: Fujifilm X100T, silver, with strap
listings.description: Silver X100T with the 23mm f/2 lens. Shutter count around 18k. Two batteries, charger and a leather strap. Small scuff on the top plate, glass is clean. Selling because I only shoot with my phone now that I'm chasing kids.

listings.title: Black quilted leather moto jacket, women's S
listings.description: Real leather moto with quilted shoulders and silver zips, women's small. Soft and broken in, no tears, lining intact. Fits slightly cropped. Moving abroad and it won't fit in the suitcase.

listings.title: Large black cubby bookcase, 6 x 8 grid
listings.description: Big painted black bookcase, about 9 feet wide and 7 feet tall, 48 cubbies. It comes apart into three sections. Some chipped paint on the edges. You'll need a van and a friend. Books and objects not included.

listings.title: Acoustic parlor guitar, natural finish
listings.description: Small-bodied acoustic, great for couch playing or travel. Plays in tune, action is a bit high. Some wear on the top and a few dings on the edges. I'll leave the strings on. Stored at my friend's place near McCarren Park.

listings.title: Marshall Major II wired headphones, black
listings.description: Marshall Major II on-ear headphones with the coiled cable. Sound is great, pads are a bit worn but not peeling. The headband folds. Can meet at the Nassau Ave G stop.

listings.title: Round white tulip table with two bentwood chairs
listings.description: White pedestal table, 32" round, seats two comfortably or three if you're friendly. The two chairs have molded plywood frames and black faux-leather seats and backs. Small ring mark on the tabletop that you only see in raking light. Plants and book not included. Pending pickup Sunday, I'll update if it falls through.

listings.title: Grey tufted three-seat sofa, 84"
listings.description: Light grey linen-look sofa with a button-tufted back and dark wood legs, 84" wide, 34" deep. Very comfortable, no stains, cushions still hold their shape. Pillows and the coffee table stayed with me. Sold to a lovely couple from Windsor Terrace, thanks everyone.

listings.title: Black metal desk lamp with brass details, adjustable arm
listings.description: Matte black task lamp with a brass collar and a counterweighted arm that swings and tilts. Round weighted base, about 20" tall. Takes a regular E26 bulb (warm LED included). Used for a client staging and then went back in the box. Succulent not included.

listings.title: Big spider plant in a teal ceramic pot with saucer
listings.description: Healthy spider plant, about 18" across, in a glossy teal ceramic pot (6" diameter) with a matching saucer. It's thrown off two babies already, which I'm happy to include in a jar. Easy plant, likes bright indirect light. Books not included. Pickup near Smith St.

listings.title: Black floral crossbody bag with chain strap
listings.description: Small structured crossbody in black with a pink and green floral print, gold push-lock clasp and a chain shoulder strap. Fits a phone, cards and keys, not much else. Carried it to two weddings. Sunglasses not included.

listings.title: 1974 Volkswagen Thing, orange, convertible
listings.description: 1974 VW Type 181 "Thing" in its original orange, with whitewalls and painted red wheels. Fold-down windshield, removable doors, new soft top in the trunk. 1600cc air-cooled engine rebuilt in 2021, about 4,000 miles since. Floors are solid, some patina on the rear quarters. NY title in my name. Garaged in Gowanus. A buyer is coming with a mechanic on Thursday, will update.

listings.title: Three plush Scandinavian holiday gnomes
listings.description: Set of three fabric gnomes, about 14" tall: one with a red polka-dot hat, one in a cream knit hat with a brown beard, one in a red and white woven hat. Bought them for a holiday window display and they're too cute to throw away. Sold as a set. Getting a head start before December.

listings.title: Black integrated stereo amplifier with phono input
listings.description: Black 90s integrated amp with the "Super Stable" circuit. Built-in phono stage, so you can plug a turntable straight in. Inputs for CD, tuner, aux and tape, plus loudness and source direct. Both channels clean, no scratchy pots. Some wear on the top panel. Speakers not included. Come hear it before you buy.

listings.title: Pair of white cube desktop speakers
listings.description: Small white cube speakers, about 4" each, on angled stands with silver trim. Powered over USB with a 3.5mm input. Surprisingly decent for a desk or a kitchen counter. Have the original box. Someone's picking them up after work.

listings.title: Vintage light blue steel road bike, 54cm, 10-speed
listings.description: 70s steel road bike in pale blue with downtube shifters, drop bars wrapped in blue tape and a black saddle. 54cm frame, fits riders about 5'6" to 5'10". New cables and brake pads last month, shifts cleanly. Paint has a few chips. Test ride welcome with ID.

listings.title: 2016 Harley-Davidson Sportster Forty-Eight, 9,400 miles
listings.description: Black 2016 Forty-Eight, 1200cc, 9,400 miles. Fat front tire, solo seat with a removable passenger pad and backrest. Serviced in August, new battery. Never dropped. Clean NY title in hand. Parked in Clinton Hill, serious buyers only please.

listings.title: Two pairs of leather boxing gloves, 14 oz and 16 oz
listings.description: One blue and white pair (16 oz) and one red pair (14 oz), both real leather with velcro wrist straps. Broken in but no splits in the padding, and they've been aired out and wiped down. Good for bag work or a partner who wants to start. Selling both together.

listings.title: Bright 1BR with open kitchen, Bed-Stuy — $2,550/mo
listings.description: Lease takeover for my cousin's one-bedroom, she's moving to Atlanta. Big open living room and kitchen, oak floors, tall windows, and a separate bedroom behind sliding doors that fits a queen. Third floor of a brownstone, 6 minutes to the Utica Ave A/C. Available Dec 1, lease runs through next August with the option to renew. The desk and chairs can stay if you want them. No broker fee.

listings.title: White Casio G-Shock GA-100, navy dial
listings.description: G-Shock GA-100 in white with the navy and blue dial. Keeps perfect time, light and alarm work, new battery in the spring. Strap is clean, a few marks on the bezel. Don't wear it anymore since I got a smartwatch.

listings.title: Hollow-body archtop electric guitar, dark sunburst
listings.description: Full hollow-body archtop with a single cutaway, dark brown sunburst, two humbuckers, gold hardware and a trapeze tailpiece. Plays great for jazz and blues, warm neck pickup. Some buckle rash on the back. Gig bag included. Sold, thanks for all the messages.

listings.title: Khaki hooded dog parka, size L
listings.description: Khaki water-resistant dog coat with a hood and fleece lining, size L (chest about 26", back length 20"). That's our pit mix Juno in it, about 45 lb. She got a new one from her grandma, so this one's up for grabs. Washed and ready.

listings.title: Two Android phones, Nexus 5 and Nexus 4, unlocked
listings.description: Two old Google phones, both factory reset and unlocked. The Nexus 5 (16GB) has a good screen and a tired battery that lasts about half a day. The Nexus 4 has a small crack on the back glass, screen is fine. Good as a backup phone, a kid's first phone, or for tinkering with custom ROMs. One USB cable included. Sold together.

listings.title: Apple Watch Series 3, 42mm space grey, black sport band
listings.description: Series 3 GPS, 42mm space grey aluminum with the black sport band. Battery health 86%. Unpaired and reset, ready for a new iPhone. Light scuffs on the case edge, screen has no scratches. Magnetic charger included. Can meet at the 30th Ave stop.

listings.title: Furnished room in 2BR, Astoria — $1,400/mo
listings.description: Big bright room in a 2BR near Ditmars, available Nov 15. Comes furnished with a queen bed with storage drawers, two nightstands and lamps, or I can clear it out. You'd share the apartment with me (software engineer, quiet, out at the office three days a week) and my cat. Open kitchen with an island and a dishwasher, and a living room with a big sofa. Closet, laundry in the building. Utilities around $70. Looking for someone for at least 6 months.

listings.description: Soft fabric cat cave, coral outside with a lime green rim, about 16" tall. Our cat napped in it for exactly one week and then went back to my laptop bag. Machine washable cover, just washed. The cat in the photo is not included, sadly.

listings.title: Parking spot in secure garage, LIC — $300/mo
listings.description: Indoor parking spot in my building's garage off Jackson Ave, roll-up door with keypad entry. Fits a sedan or small SUV, not a full-size pickup. Available month to month starting now since I sold my car. Five minutes to the Court Sq station. Venmo or check on the 1st.

listings.title: Wooden backgammon set in folding case
listings.description: Full-size wooden backgammon board, natural and black inlay, folds into a case with metal latches. All 30 checkers and both dice are there. Played a handful of times at my parents' place. Pickup in Jackson Heights on weekends or Astoria on weekdays.

listings.title: Triumph Thruxton 900 cafe racer, white, 11k miles
listings.description: 2014 Thruxton 900 in white, about 11,000 miles. Brown tuck-and-roll seat, clip-on bars, spoked wheels. Fuel injected, starts easily even in the cold. New rear tire last season, chain and sprockets in good shape. I commuted on it to LIC but it's mostly been parked since I went remote. On hold for a buyer coming Saturday.

listings.title: Free: red upholstered armchair
listings.description: Boxy armchair in red wool fabric with light wood legs. Comfortable and sturdy, fabric is a little pilled on the arms. No pets, no smoking, no bugs. It's out front of my building off Troutman right now, come grab it before the sanitation truck does.

listings.title: Peugeot Looxor 50cc scooter, black
listings.description: Black Peugeot Looxor 50, two-stroke, around 9,000 km. Starts on the button once it's warm, kick start always works. Seat is clean, mirrors and lights all work, a few scratches on the side panels. Good for short city runs. Has the title, no plates. Selling because I'm moving at the end of the month.

listings.title: Two surfboards: 9'0" longboard and 7'6" funboard
listings.description: White 9'0" single-fin longboard and a navy 7'6" funboard. Both water-tight, a couple of professional ding repairs on the longboard rail. Good for Rockaway. $380 for both or $220 / $180 separately. Fins included. You need a car or a very patient bus driver.

listings.title: Metric socket set with 1/4" ratchet, in case
listings.description: 1/4" drive set with chrome sockets from 4 to 14mm, bit sockets, extension and a quick-release ratchet, all in a black hard case. Nothing missing that I know of. Used it to keep my scooter going. Moving and trying to lighten the load.

listings.title: 10-gallon aquarium kit with hood, filter and decor
listings.description: Standard 10-gallon glass tank (20" x 10" x 12") with a black hood, light and hang-on filter. Comes with the gravel, rock, driftwood and fake plants. Doesn't leak. The goldfish found a new home with my neighbor's kid. Pickup only, near the Seneca Ave M.

listings.title: Lot of 20+ vintage LEGO minifigures, 70s and 80s
listings.description: Classic minifigs from my childhood: red and white Space astronauts, castle knights with helmets, town figures, plus the printed Legoland Snack Bar and Police bricks and a few printed slopes. Some play wear on the prints, no cracked torsos. Sold to a collector in Ridgewood.

listings.title: Stack of eight antique cloth hardcovers
listings.description: Eight old cloth-bound books, early 1900s to 1940s, including In Tune with the Infinite, The Transforming Friendship and an anthology of English poems. Spines are faded and a couple of the top ones are fraying, pages intact. Lovely on a shelf or a coffee table. Selling as a lot.

listings.title: Three vintage suitcases, stackable
listings.description: Tan leather case on top, a striped red, blue and yellow "Cabin" case in the middle and a big brown one at the bottom. All latches open and close, the brown one has a key. Scuffs, travel stickers and character. They've been in my sister's hall closet in Harlem for years, pickup there. Great as side-table storage.

listings.title: Mohair teddy bear in a hand-knit blue sweater
listings.description: Golden mohair teddy, about 12" tall, jointed arms and legs, wearing a blue sweater I knitted for him. Stitched eyes and nose, so safe for little ones. Clean and stored in a smoke-free home. Looking for a grandchild who'll actually play with him.

listings.title: Bundle of 12 summer dresses, women's S–M
listings.description: Twelve dresses my daughter left behind when she moved to Portland: florals, a mint green slip dress, a teal maxi, a couple of pastel sundresses. Sizes S to M, mostly 4–8. All washed. Hangers included. Happy to let you look through them in the lobby.

listings.title: 1960s portable TV on tapered legs
listings.description: Black and white portable set with silver trim on its original tapered metal stand. It powers on and hums, but you'd need a converter box and probably a repair to get a picture. Mostly a decor piece now, and a good one. About 3 feet tall on the legs. The doorman can help you load it.

listings.title: Lot of old hand tools: hatchet, hammers, ice tongs and more
listings.description: My late husband's tools from the country house: hatchet with leather sheath, claw hammer, ball-peen hammer, Craftsman steel tape, ice tongs, a hay hook, two pocket knives, a flashlight, an oil can and work gloves. Patina and rust as you'd expect, handles are solid. I'd love them to go to someone who'll use them. Sold as a lot.

listings.title: Daniel Wellington Classic watch, rose gold, 36mm
listings.description: Classic DW with a white dial, rose gold case and dark brown leather strap. A gift from my grandchildren that I never got used to wearing, I'm a Timex person. New battery, a few marks on the strap keeper. Original box.

listings.title: About 8 lb of loose LEGO, mixed colors
listings.description: Big bin of mixed LEGO bricks, plates, technic beams, wheels and a few windows. Roughly 8 pounds, all genuine LEGO, no instructions or complete sets. Washed in a mesh bag before listing. The kids have moved on to video games, so we're reclaiming the closet.

listings.title: Three strollers: two umbrella and one full-size
listings.description: Black umbrella stroller, a red umbrella stroller with a padded liner, and a full-size grey stroller with a big basket. All fold, all brakes work, wheels roll straight. $100 for all three or $40 each. Bags and blanket not included. Holding them for a family from church until Friday.

listings.title: Free: shelf of kids' paperbacks, about 40 books
listings.description: Picture books and early readers: Dr. Seuss, Fireman Sam, science experiment books and a bunch of South African readers from my wife's family. Some covers are worn but every page is there. Take the whole stack. I'll put them in a box on our stoop on Park Place.

listings.title: 2013 Volkswagen Beetle, pale yellow, 68k miles
listings.description: 2013 Beetle 2.5L automatic in pale yellow, 68,000 miles. Clean Carfax, two owners, all service at the VW dealer in Brooklyn. New front brakes and battery this year. Small door ding on the passenger side. We bought a minivan when baby number two arrived. Parked at my brother's in Ditmas Park, test drives on weekends.

listings.title: Drive-up storage unit sublet, Red Hook — $160/mo
listings.description: Ground-floor 5x10 drive-up unit at a storage place in Red Hook, roll-up door, 24-hour access with a code. I prepaid through March and we no longer need it. You take over at $160/month, cheaper than the walk-in rate. Fits a studio's worth of boxes or a couple of bikes.

listings.title: Large glass hamster habitat with wheel, house and ladder
listings.description: Long glass habitat, about 40" x 20", with a ventilated wooden mesh lid, wooden wheel, two-story house, ladder and a hideout. Way better than the plastic cages. Our hamster lived a long happy life in it. Cleaned out, bedding not included. The bookcase stand isn't included either. Bring two people.

listings.title: Kids' quad roller skates, two pairs (youth 3 and 5)
listings.description: One red pair (youth 3) and one black Roller Derby Firestar pair (youth 5). Wheels and bearings roll smoothly, toe stops have plenty of life, laces and velcro straps intact. Our two learned on these at the Prospect Park rink. $35 for both or $20 each.

listings.title: Furnished loft sublet, Greenpoint, Nov–Apr — $3,600/mo
listings.description: My loft is available while I'm in Berlin: November through April, possibly longer. About 900 sq ft in an old brick factory: exposed brick, timber beams, big windows and wide-plank pine floors. Open kitchen with a big island and a gas range, a sofa and two armchairs around the fireplace. The bedroom is a separate room off the kitchen, plus a sleeping loft up the stairs for guests, and the bathroom has a soaking tub. Fully furnished, utilities and wifi included. Ten minutes to the Greenpoint Ave G. Ideal for a quiet person or a couple who'll water the plants.

listings.title: Cognac leather butterfly chair, black frame
listings.description: Butterfly chair with a cognac leather sling on a black steel frame. The leather has softened and darkened nicely, no tears. Frame folds flat for transport. Throw and pillow not included. Was the best reading spot in my apartment.

listings.title: Konica Auto S3 rangefinder, 38mm f/1.8
listings.description: Compact rangefinder with the sharp Hexanon 38mm f/1.8. Shutter-priority auto exposure works with a modern battery adapter, which I include. Rangefinder patch is bright, glass is clean, light seals replaced. Shot a roll last month to test. Sold.

listings.title: Canon EF 24mm f/1.4L plus two vintage primes
listings.description: Canon EF 24mm f/1.4L (first version) with both caps, plus two vintage manual lenses: a 50mm f/1.7 and a 28mm f/2.8 macro, which need adapters on modern bodies. The 24L autofocuses quickly and has no haze or fungus. $680 for all three, or $620 for the Canon alone and $40 each for the others.

listings.title: Brown leather weekender duffle with shoulder strap
listings.description: Big distressed brown leather duffle with two front pockets, side buckles and a detachable shoulder strap. Fits three or four days of clothes and a camera. Zipper runs smoothly, canvas lining is clean. It's too heavy to take on the plane, which is why it's going. On hold until Thursday.

listings.title: Gold aviator sunglasses, blue mirrored lenses, with case
listings.description: Thin gold metal frames with polarized blue mirrored lenses and the round metal case. No scratches on the lenses, nose pads replaced. I can meet at Tompkins Square Park on Thursday, or in Greenpoint any evening.

listings.title: Tan leather wingtip chukka boots, men's 10
listings.description: Cognac leather wingtip chukkas with brogue detailing, men's US 10. Bought for a shoot and worn a few times since. Soles have plenty left, a little creasing at the toes. Tie and camera in the photo are not part of the sale.

listings.title: Black step-through city bike with wicker basket
listings.description: Upright step-through bike, black frame, blue tires, wicker front basket and a floral chain guard. Three-speed internal hub, coaster brake plus a front hand brake, front light. Perfect for grocery runs. Lock included. Moving to Berlin where I'll finally have a real Dutch bike.

listings.title: Free: warm white LED string lights, about 5 strands
listings.description: A tangle of warm white LED fairy lights, around 5 strands of 10m each, plug-in. They all work, they're just very tangled. Used them as a backdrop in my studio. Free to whoever has the patience. Pickup near McGuinness.

listings.title: Orange corduroy bolster dog bed, medium
listings.description: Orange corduroy bed with a raised bolster on three sides, about 30" x 24". Removable, washable cover, just washed. Our corgi Biscuit is staying with my parents in Jersey and they already bought her a new one. Corgi not included, she's very sorry.
